correctness.rationale: Table 1 values \(F_{1m}=1/3\) and \(F_{3m}=1\) force \(I_x:I_y:I_z=3:2:1\). Literal normalization of the printed middle inertial term \((I_x-I_z)xz\) therefore gives \(F_{2m}=+1\), while the table defines \((I_z-I_x)/I_y=-1\). For \(H=(3x_1^2+2x_2^2+x_3^2)/2\), the cubic inertial coefficient is exactly 0 for the table sign and 4 for the printed sign. Independent rational arithmetic reproduced these identities.
